analysis: This PR only changes documentation: changelog.d/flint-paged-only-defaults.md (new) and docs/architecture/inference.md (the Flint section around base lines 2058-2069). No source code is in the supplied units, so the described behavior (Flint paged-only, native KV/checkpoint precision ignoring the provider-wide `balanced` default, refusal on contiguous selection, paged kill switch, capability veto or paged construction failure) is a claim about code outside the evidence. I could not verify that EngineV2Factory.prepareProductionBackend or EngineV2KVQuantizationPolicy.resolve actually implement it. Security-wise the doc describes tightening: fail-closed refusal instead of degrading to an unqualified contiguous path, and reduced precision still refused when explicitly requested. That does not weaken any threat-model control. The prefix-cache threat T-041 (SSD tier, HMAC names, TTL, account-scoped salt) is not touched by the visible diff. Paged-vs-contiguous could affect the prefix-cache or KV-cache plumbing, but the docs show no change to the cache gate, TTL, name derivation or scope. The base_text excerpt of inference.md is unrelated to the Flint edit and has no other changed lines in this batch. Remaining integration question for a pass with code: confirm the code matches the doc (the automatic-to-explicit paged promotion, that no fallback to contiguous remains, and that a kill-switch refusal does not create a crash-loop or availability issue for the provider). The patch excerpt for inference.md is truncated, so the tail of the changed hunk was not fully seen. No findings.
